name: 15901 · Johnstown, PA
findings: ZIP 15901 (Johnstown) has 107 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15901 (Johnstown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15901 (Johnstown) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 8% of all organizations here have no identified type.
